entities.summary: Helmar Gunter Frank was a German mathematician and pedagogist. He was among the first scientists to apply mathematical methods in teaching and psychology. He established a method to measure intelligence on an absolute and homogeneous scale rather than by comparison between individuals, see information processing theory, and became in such a way the founder of the Erlangen School of Information Psychology.
